response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and demonstrated hands-on work with agentic workflows and event-driven systems, but lacks clear evidence of executive leadership at scale, regulated fintech deployment, or building multi-agent AI systems in production with financial consequences — key requirements for a CTO role in this domain.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in event-driven, distributed systems (GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture contributions via testing, CI/CD, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No demonstrable experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulated financial systems
Lacks evidence of scaling engineering teams beyond 10+ people or leading senior technical leaders
No clear track record of architecting model-agnostic, auditable AI systems with real-time financial feedback loops
